brief:
Israeli occupation forces escalated airstrikes on Nabatieh governorate in southern Lebanon during Tuesday evening and Wednesday dawn, Shehab Wire reported. The bombardment caused widespread material damage and sparked panic among residents in the area.

The Lebanese news agency documented the intensified aerial operations targeting the southern region. The strikes prompted significant concern among the civilian population as raids continued through the night and into early morning hours. The scope of structural and infrastructural damage from the campaign remained under assessment.
